cohort: 150 pregnant women hospitalized after 40 weeks of gestation at the Department of Obstetrics & Gynecology, Narayan Medical College & Hospital, Jamuhar, Sasaram, India, from July 2021 to September 2022.
finding: Prolonged gestation is strongly correlated with an increased likelihood of perinatal complications, including fetal distress and obstetric complications like cephalopelvic disproportion, deep transverse arrest, and caesarean section, with higher prevalence in primigravida women compared to multigravida women.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between mode of delivery and gestational age, but caesarean delivery at 42 weeks was associated with a decreased APGAR score of 4.
